dict.string: During a study session (or a sensor test or posture recording you start): analyzes one low-res frame per second on this Mac to notice if you're on your phone. Frames are never saved or sent anywhere.
During a study session (or a sensor test you start): classifies room sound (music, speech, laughter, writing) on this Mac to notice phone use. No audio is recorded, saved or sent anywhere.

During a study session: reads the active browser tab's title and address to check it's study-related, and (if you turn them on) sends reminders to your iPhone through Messages and runs your Focus shortcuts.
